feature: URL submission rejects http, private, localhost, credentials-in-URL, junk
Platform detection: non-WooCommerce, unreachable and non-WordPress sites are refused (nothing stored)
evidence: https://shop.example.com does not look like a WooCommerce store with the REST API enabled (wc/v3 namespace missing).

feature: Valid key connects; read access verified; write permission honestly reported as unverified
Wrong secret / malformed key rejected without storing anything
Key revoked/expired AFTER connecting: next sync fails visibly and the connection state tells the owner to re-authorise
actual: sync=502 code=AUTH_REJECTED status=CONNECTED health=DEGRADED lastError="The store rejected the credentials or the key lacks permission for this action."
evidence: Failure IS reported; but connection.status remains CONNECTED, so the UI badge stays green.

feature: Read-only key: reads work, every write refused, local data unchanged, failure audited
After a read-only refusal, the capability list stops presenting write features as supported
expected: write capabilities not shown as SUPPORTED
evidence: Manifest is static per platform; it never learns that this key is read-only.

feature: Two websites on one account: separate credentials, separate data, plan limit enforced, disconnect of one leaves the other working
actual: freePlanSecondSite=403 items=2 sameSKUbothKept=true afterDisconnect: other=200 disconnected=409

feature: Catalog/orders APIs can be filtered by website when several are connected
IP-literal encodings of private addresses rejected at URL submission
safeRequest itself refuses private IP-literal targets (defence in depth behind URL validation)
actual: 127.0.0.1 -> "connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:443" ; 169.254.169.254 -> "Hostname/IP does not match certificate's altnames: IP: 169.254.169.254 is not in the cert's list: "
evidence: Node skips dns lookup for IP literals, so the connect-time guard never runs; the connection is attempted. Only validatePublicUrl stops this today. Same pattern in the older safeGet/safePost.

feature: Synced products match the source store field-by-field (name, sku, price, stock, category)
Product on sale: SitePulse shows the store's regular price AND does not hide the sale price
evidence: Only regular_price is stored; the sale price actually charged to customers is not visible.

feature: Products without managed stock are not shown as OUT_OF_STOCK
Product variations (variable products) are discovered
Product descriptions are discovered
All product images discovered (not just the first)
Categories are discovered and exposed by the API
evidence: Categories are read during sync but the result is discarded; only the product's first category name is kept.

feature: Pages are discovered and exposed by the API
evidence: connector.readPages exists but no route or sync step calls it.

feature: Order details required by Manager Hub: customer, items, total, status AND delivery address/contact
Product deleted on the store is not shown as live forever
Large store (2,500 products): truncation is reported, never silent
evidence: Hard cap of 20 pages x 100; the remaining 500 products are never synced and there is no way to continue.

feature: Existing administrative functionality is discovered
evidence: Not implemented; honestly labelled (this test checks the label, not the capability).

feature: Mode A: manifest lists only real capabilities; unbuilt features are labelled, not functional
Mode A: Manager Hub only offered when order API is available (store without orders access)
expected: order capabilities absent/unsupported when orders endpoint refused
evidence: A store without the orders endpoint fails the WHOLE sync (products too) and the manifest still advertises order management.

feature: Mode B: replicate existing dashboards
actual: NOT IMPLEMENTED. No code discovers or recreates existing dashboards for any platform.
evidence: Declared unsupported in Phase 15/16 reports; recorded here as a failing requirement, not hidden.

feature: Combined mode: capability ids unique, no overlapping/conflicting hub assignment
Price change in SitePulse reaches the store and is verified against the store's response
Store answers 200 but stored a different price: SitePulse must NOT claim success
evidence: Connector returns remotePrice but the route ignores it: local says 999, store says 1.

feature: Update product name/description from SitePulse
Change product image from SitePulse
Stock update reaches the store; order completion reaches the store
Other order status changes (cancel / on-hold / refund) can be made from SitePulse
Change made directly on the store arrives by polling fallback
Webhook: signed event applied; forged event rejected; replay ignored
Webhook events arriving OUT OF ORDER do not overwrite newer state with older
evidence: Upsert applies whichever event arrives last; date_modified is ignored.

feature: Conflict: store price changed externally after last sync; SitePulse write must detect/refuse the stale edit
evidence: No version/modified check: SitePulse silently overwrites the external change.

feature: Transient store error (503 once) is retried for reads
evidence: No retry inside a single sync; the poller retries later with back-off.

feature: Store timeout: clean failure, lock released, health DEGRADED, recovery works
Concurrent syncs of one site do not run twice
"Change this shirt's price to Rs. 999." -> proposal for the right product, nothing executed
actual: PROPOSAL: Change the price of "Shirt" (SKU-11) from 100 to 999 on the connected website.

feature: Confirming executes once on the store; second confirm refused
"Show all pending orders." returns only pending orders
"Find products with low stock." lists exactly the low ones
"Update this product description." is refused as unsupported (not pretended)
actual: UNSUPPORTED: Editing descriptions, images, banners and categories is not implemented yet. Supported: prices, stock, order completion, and read-only questions.
evidence: Honest refusal; the feature itself is missing (see SYNC-03).

feature: Exact name wins over substring: "T-Shirt" vs "Shirt"
actual: CLARIFY: More than one product matches. Please use the exact name or SKU.

feature: Number formats: "Rs. 1,299.50" and negative/absurd prices
actual: a=PROPOSAL(Change the price of "Shirt" (SKU-11) from 100 to 1299.5 on the connected website.) b=UNSUPPORTED c=undefined

feature: Manager cannot obtain or confirm price proposals; cross-tenant proposal confirm refused
Prompt-injection style text inside a product name cannot trigger actions
Secrets never appear in any API response, export, audit log or logger output
actual: leaking surfaces=[]; plaintext in backup files=false
evidence: webhook secret shown once in the connect response by design.

feature: Tenant B cannot read/modify tenant A's site: connect, sync, disconnect, manifest, webhooks, orders, catalog
actual: statuses=404,404,404,404 catalog=0 orders=0 sites=0 A still connected=true

feature: Inbound webhook for tenant A's site signed with tenant B's site secret is rejected
Owner/Manager boundaries on every new route
expected: manager: connect 403, disconnect 403, price 403; sync allowed

feature: Sessions: no token, garbage token, logged-out token and expired token are refused on connector routes
Sensitive actions: remote writes need confirm:true; every connect/disconnect/sync/write (success and failure) is audited with actor
Credential-guessing is rate limited
Disconnected site: no outbound call reaches the store and inbound webhooks are refused
2,000-product sync: time, DB growth, event-loop responsiveness
expected: completes < 5 s; /health p99 < 100 ms during sync

feature: Catalog list API is paginated and searchable for large catalogs
actual: unpaginated list returns 2000 items (568 KB); limit=50 ignored (returned 2000); search ok=true (0.6 ms/query)

feature: Orders feed paginated for 5,000 orders
Persistence cost: each commit rewrites the whole DB file (5,000 records)
actual: store.save() = 3 ms for 2000 catalog records (synchronous, blocks the event loop)

feature: Poor network: store hangs/very slow -> request fails within a bounded time
expected: bounded by timeout (8 s per request)
actual: Not executed: the 8 s timeout lives in the real HTTPS client (safeRequest); the double bypasses it. Covered by the real-socket suite (REAL-*).
